name: legal-page
title: Legal page
description: The site's legal pages (terms, privacy): the header, the page head with the title, the lead and the ASCII drift, then the text in the head's columns (the sections at the 640px measure on the left, their list staying in view on the right) and the footer.
use_for: Terms of service, privacy, cookies. `page` picks the terms or the privacy copy; `preparing` shows only the head, its lead saying the text is on its way (the site's state until the text is ready); the text is a placeholder: put what your counsel approves in lib/pages/legal.ts or pass `content`.
never: Text set in gray or under 16px: the sections read in White at 16/24
A display-size title: the page head's section head
source: Site app/terms and app/privacy (AsciiTrail, Header, PageHead with the title and the 'being prepared' lead, Footer: the `preparing` state); the text in the site's type: .t-sub subheads (h6, h5 from 768), 16/24 paragraphs in --text at --measure, the page head's 7fr and 5fr columns; --section-y under it
body:
`sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`head`, `body`); a key left out is not shown. `menus` passes the
header menus (the live card's `picture`, the use cases' `shots`).

props.name: sections
props.description: The sections to show, in order; all of them in the page order by default (leave one out to omit it).
